description: Interactive web browser automation: navigating URLs, clicking elements, reading dynamic web pages, and taking screenshots via Playwright.
routing_rules: Assign when a task requires rendering modern JavaScript websites, logging into web dashboards, or visual UI verification.

tools.name: browser_navigate
tools.description: Navigates to a target URL in the browser and waits for the page to load.

tools.name: browser_read_content
tools.description: Reads the visible text, headers, and interactive DOM layout of the current browser page.

tools.name: browser_click
tools.description: Clicks an interactive button, link, or element on the current page.

tools.name: browser_type
tools.description: Enters text into a form input, textarea, or contenteditable element.

tools.name: browser_scroll
tools.description: Scrolls the browser viewport in the specified direction.

tools.name: browser_screenshot
tools.description: Captures a screenshot of the current page and stores it in the artifacts directory.

tools.name: browser_snapshot
tools.description: Captures the structural accessibility DOM snapshot of the current page.

tools.name: browser_take_screenshot
tools.description: Captures a visual image of the current page for layout verification.

tools.name: browser_get_dom_map
tools.description: Extracts clickable interactive elements with their CSS selectors and coordinates.
